FIGHT together against different enemies in the Hex7 Battle Arena.
DEFEND yourself with shield and sword and don't forget to RELOAD your guns once in awhile.                                                                                                                                                           
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974468_332017743231769_3438180485989163490_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=CQBCV-OemEIQ7kNvgGC6mao&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCcbGwKB7aoQGnyJln3cu370O_ubjzZBVBnvWXU9LPr5w&oe=674EE9B7)

Have FUN customizing your game a much as you like.
